name: Shirasato Karin
source:
[b]The Literature Club's Leader, secretive about her feelings and emotions (Temporary)[/b]

Takumi's junior, who is one year younger than him. Kaede's younger sister.

A member of the literary club who also works as a shrine maiden. She's quite shy and doesn't talk much. She spends time in the literary club room writing her own stories.

Due to a certain incident, she only shows her emotions to Takumi.

[Description from [url=https://x.com/sekaiproject/status/1999184927397642631]Sekai Project's X Twitter[/url]]
